The text does not expressly address a fully automated process with no professional involved. But limiting AI to a supporting role with the professional's work prevailing strongly implies it is not allowed. Clients must be given information about the AI systems the professional uses, in clear, simple and exhaustive language. The files do not state any fine or sanction for failing to tell clients. Art. 13 contains no penalty. The other file, art. 10-bis of L. 212/2000 on abuse of rights in tax law, is unrelated to this question. Whether the studio counts as a "professione intellettuale" is not addressed in the files, and I have assumed it does.
